tldr: 台股中秋連假前量縮走弱，權值股承壓，台積電隨美股回檔收低。
AI 與先進製程需求不墜，高通新旗艦晶片採台積電 2 奈米，供應鏈續受關注。
監理面同步推進：壽險 TIS 資本首考可望全數過關，金管會並放寬股票型基金與主動式 ETF 單一持股上限。

items.title_zh: 台股中秋連假前量縮 權值股走弱
items.title_en: TAIEX eases before Mid-Autumn break as heavyweights soften
items.summary_zh: 加權指數收約 48,025 點、跌約 133 點（-0.28%），成交量縮至約 7,366 億元。台積電跌 25 元、收 2,475 元（-1.0%），鴻海跌 2.14%，主因隔夜美股四大指數全黑拖累權值股。法人認為 AI 需求強勁、外銷訂單高檔，加上台積電 10 月中法說會可望釋出正向展望，仍支撐台股中期多方格局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index closed the pre-holiday session around 48,025 points, down about 133 points (-0.28%) on thinner turnover of roughly NT$736.6bn. TSMC fell NT$25 (-1.0%) to NT$2,475 and Hon Hai dropped 2.14%, tracking an overnight retreat across the four major U.S. indices. Institutions still see AI demand, high export orders and TSMC's mid-October earnings call as supports for the medium-term uptrend.

items.title_zh: 台積電 ADR 小跌 台股上檔受抑
items.title_en: TSMC ADR edges lower, capping local upside
items.summary_zh: 台積電美國 ADR 於 9 月 25 日下跌 0.54 美元（-0.12%），換算約合台股 2,864 元，仍較台北掛牌價有溢價。ADR 走弱加上台指期夜盤下跌 169 點至 47,956 點，暗示連假後開盤偏保守；惟現股相對 ADR 折價，顯示這檔權值指標下檔空間有限。
items.summary_en: TSMC's U.S.-listed ADR slipped US$0.54 (-0.12%) on Sept 25, converting to about NT$2,864 per share and leaving a premium over the Taipei-listed price. The soft ADR and a lower overnight TAIEX futures night session (down 169 points to 47,956) pointed to a cautious open after the holiday, though the discount of local shares to the ADR suggests limited downside for the market bellwether.

items.title_zh: 高通旗艦晶片採台積電 2 奈米 先進製程供應鏈聚焦
items.title_en: Qualcomm flagship chips on TSMC 2nm keep advanced-node chain in focus
items.summary_zh: 高通最新發表的兩款旗艦手機晶片均採用台積電 2 奈米製程，凸顯先進製程需求對台灣半導體供應鏈的支撐。分析師預期 2 奈米放量與相關封裝、材料供應商將成第四季投資焦點，強化今年帶動台股上漲的 AI 與行動裝置題材。
items.summary_en: Qualcomm's two newly unveiled flagship smartphone processors are both built on TSMC's 2nm process, underscoring how leading-edge demand is anchoring Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain. Analysts expect the 2nm ramp and related packaging and materials suppliers to draw investor attention into the fourth quarter, reinforcing the AI-and-mobile narrative that has driven this year's equity gains.

items.title_zh: 美科技股走弱 台大型科技股表現分歧
items.title_en: Weak U.S. tech lead pressures Taiwan large-cap tech names
items.summary_zh: 台積電、鴻海、台達電、聯發科等權值科技股受隔夜美股下跌影響、表現分歧。鴻海跌 2.14% 至 250.5 元；聯發科逆勢漲 1.92% 至 5,285 元，台達電漲 0.52% 至 1,910 元，顯示 AI 伺服器與網通相關供應鏈在科技股回檔中仍具選擇性韌性。
items.summary_en: Heavyweight tech stocks including TSMC, Hon Hai, Delta Electronics and MediaTek moved unevenly as an overnight decline in U.S. equities weighed on sentiment. Hon Hai fell 2.14% to NT$250.5 while MediaTek bucked the trend, rising 1.92% to NT$5,285 and Delta added 0.52% to NT$1,910, showing selective resilience in AI-server and networking-linked suppliers despite the broader tech pullback.

items.title_zh: 壽險 TIS 資本首考 可望全數過關
items.title_en: Life insurers on track to clear first TIS solvency test
items.summary_zh: 依新版台灣保險業清償能力制度（TIS），2026 至 2028 年半年報須於 9 月底前申報，首份半年報本月亮牌。金管會公布的計算方式顯示，各壽險公司上半年 TIS 可望全數站上 100% 法定合格線，緩解市場對制度由 RBC 過渡後資本適足性的疑慮。
items.summary_en: Under the new Taiwan Insurance Solvency (TIS) regime, semi-annual reports must be filed by end-September for 2026-2028, with the first half-year filing due this month. The FSC's calculation method suggests all life insurers should clear the 100% statutory qualifying line for first-half TIS, easing market concern about capital adequacy after the transition from the previous RBC framework.

items.title_zh: 金管會 10 月政策接力上路 高雄專區、虛擬資產在列
items.title_en: FSC lines up October policy push on Kaohsiung hub and virtual assets
items.summary_zh: 金管會規劃 10 月推出一系列措施，包括高雄金融專區與虛擬資產新規，釋出深化資本市場、打造亞洲資產管理中心的積極訊號。相關進程指向更多商品與跨境開放，可望擴大銀行與券商的手續費收入來源。
items.summary_en: The regulator is set to roll out a cluster of measures in October, including a Kaohsiung financial special zone and new virtual-asset rules, signaling a more active agenda to deepen Taiwan's capital markets and position the island as a regional asset-management centre. The pipeline points to further product and cross-border openings that could broaden fee income for banks and securities firms.

items.title_zh: 金管會放寬股票型基金、主動式 ETF 單一持股上限至 25%
items.title_en: FSC raises single-stock cap for equity funds and active ETFs to 25%
items.summary_zh: 金管會發布令放寬國內股票型基金及主動式 ETF 投資單一上市公司股票不得超過基金淨值 10% 的限制，上限提高至 25%。此舉讓基金經理人更能反映台積電等權值龍頭比重，可望為大型權值股帶來活水，同時提高投資人須留意的集中度風險。
items.summary_en: The regulator eased the rule barring domestic equity funds and active ETFs from holding more than 10% of net asset value in a single listed company, lifting the ceiling to 25%. The change gives fund managers more room to reflect index-heavy names such as TSMC in their portfolios, potentially channelling fresh flows into large-cap leaders while raising concentration-risk considerations for investors.

items.title_zh: 10 家壽險獲准辦理財富管理業務
items.title_en: Ten life insurers cleared to run wealth-management business
items.summary_zh: 截至 2026 年 5 月，包括新光、南山、富邦、國泰、凱基、台灣、保誠、安達、法國巴黎、元大等 10 家壽險公司獲金管會核准辦理財富管理業務，將高資產商品通路自銀行向保險端延伸。另南山人壽一年期「住院暨在宅急症照護」健康險本月獲准，反映針對高資產與保障型客群的商品持續創新。
items.summary_en: As of May 2026, ten insurers — including Shin Kong, Nan Shan, Fubon, Cathay, KGI, Taiwan Life, Chubb, BNP Paribas Cardif and Yuanta — have won FSC approval to offer wealth-management services, expanding high-net-worth product channels beyond banks. Separately, Nan Shan's one-year hospitalisation-and-home-acute-care health policy was approved this month, illustrating continued product innovation aimed at affluent and protection-focused clients.
